**About Spectra Solar Power**

At **Spectra Solar Power**, we are driving India’s transition toward clean, sustainable energy. Specializing in residential and Commercial & Industrial (C&I) Solar EPC solutions, we are rapidly scaling our footprint across key states. We are looking for an energetic and goal-driven **Talent Acquisition Specialist** to help build and scale our cross-functional teams—from high-volume field sales to technical engineering personnel.

**Role Overview**

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will manage end-to-end recruitment across sales, technical, project management, and corporate verticals. You will be responsible for sourcing, interviewing, and onboarding top talent to keep pace with our aggressive growth plans.

**Key Responsibilities1. Sourcing & Pipeline Building**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment cycles for technical (Solar Engineers, Project Managers, Supply Chain) and non-technical roles (B2C/B2B Direct Sales, State Heads, Back-office ops).
* Utilize multiple channels including LinkedIn, job portals (Naukri, Indeed), social media, campus drives, and local walk-in events to source quality profiles.

**2. Interviewing & Assessment**

* Screen resumes, conduct initial HR interviews, and assess candidates on functional expertise, cultural fit, and CTC/notice period expectations.
* Brief candidates on technical and market expectations (e.g., PM Surya Ghar Yojana knowledge, EPC operations, tier-1 panel ecosystems) prior to business rounds.
* Schedule and align interview loops with key hiring managers and department heads.

**3. Offer & Onboarding Operations**

* Facilitate smooth day-one onboarding in coordination with the HR Operations team.

* Opportunity to work in the fast-growing clean energy sector.

**Location:** Koparkhairane, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Experience Required:** 5–8+ Years

**Industry:** Logistics / Road Transportation / Fleet Operations

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic HR Head to lead and independently manage the complete Human Resources function. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in logistics, road transportation, fleet operations, or other manpower-intensive businesses.

The HR Head will be responsible for managing the complete employee lifecycle across corporate offices, branches, warehouses, fleet operations, drivers, and field-level teams. The role requires strong leadership, recruitment, employee relations, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, and HR operations management skills.

**Job Role**

As an HR Head, you will be responsible for developing and implementing HR strategies aligned with business objectives, managing end-to-end recruitment, overseeing HR operations, ensuring statutory compliance, and driving employee engagement and performance management.

You will work closely with senior management and business heads to address workforce requirements, improve employee productivity, establish HR policies and procedures, and build a strong HR framework to support the organization's growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. End-to-End HR Leadership

* Take complete ownership of the organization's HR function.
* Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with business and operational requirements.
* Manage HR operations across corporate offices, branches, warehouses, and field and driver workforces.
* Work closely with senior management and business heads on workforce planning and people-related matters.
* Establish HR policies, processes, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to support business growth.

2. Talent Acquisition & Manpower Planning

* Manage end-to-end recruitment across all levels and departments.
* Develop manpower plans based on business and operational requirements.
* Handle recruitment for drivers, fleet and transportation staff, warehouse employees, operations teams, and corporate employees.
* Develop effective sourcing channels for high-volume and specialized logistics recruitment.
* Monitor manpower requirements, vacancies, and recruitment timelines.

3. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Management

* Manage the complete employee lifecycle, from joining to exit.
* Oversee onboarding, attendance, leave management, transfers, confirmations, promotions, and employee separation.
* Develop, implement, and continuously improve HR policies, processes, and SOPs.
* Ensure smooth HR operations across multiple locations.
* Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation.

4. Payroll & Statutory Compliance

* Oversee payroll inputs and coordinate payroll processing.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements, including PF, ESIC, and Professional Tax.
* Manage contract labour and workforce-related compliance wherever applicable.
* Ensure timely maintenance of statutory records and HR documentation.
* Coordinate with external consultants and agencies for payroll, compliance, and other HR-related matters.

5. Employee Relations & Engagement

* Manage employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace issues.
* Develop employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Handle employee relations across operational, fleet, and field teams.
* Work closely with business leaders to resolve employee concerns and workplace issues.
* Promote a positive, productive, and supportive work environment.

6. Performance Management

* Drive performance appraisal and performance management processes.
* Establish appropriate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and performance evaluation frameworks.
* Support managers in improving employee productivity and performance.
* Identify performance gaps and recommend suitable corrective measures and development initiatives.
* Align employee performance with organizational goals and business objectives.

7. HR MIS & Analytics

* Develop and monitor HR dashboards and Management Information Systems (MIS).
* Track headcount, attrition, recruitment, manpower costs, absenteeism, and attendance.
* Monitor workforce productivity and other key HR metrics.
* Prepare regular HR reports and present insights to senior management.
* Use HR data and analytics to support business decisions and manpower planning.

8. Training & Development

* Identify training needs across different employee groups.
* Develop and implement training initiatives for operational employees and managers.
* Support driver training, safety awareness, and behavioural development programmes.
* Promote continuous learning and employee development.
* Identify opportunities to improve workforce capabilities and overall organizational effectiveness.

**Requirements**

* 5–8+ years of overall HR experience.
* Mandatory experience in the logistics industry.
* Strong hands-on experience in road logistics, road transportation, or fleet operations.
* Experience managing end-to-end HR functions independently.
* Experience handling both corporate and operational or field-level workforces.
* Strong understanding of manpower-intensive businesses.
* Hands-on experience in HR operations, recruitment, employee relations, and statutory compliance.
* Knowledge of applicable labour laws, PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, and contract labour compliance.
* Experience in payroll coordination, performance management, and workforce planning.
* Ability to independently lead and manage the complete HR function.
* Strong stakeholder management and people-management skills.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

**Important:** Candidates without relevant logistics or road transportation experience will not be considered for this position.

**Preferred Industry Background**

Candidates currently working or having previously worked with the following types of organizations are preferred:

* Road transportation companies
* Fleet management companies
* Logistics companies
* Third-Party Logistics (3PL) organizations
* Transport companies
* Supply chain organizations
* Other manpower-intensive logistics businesses

Preferred Skills

* Strong leadership and team-management abilities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong knowledge of HR policies, processes, and statutory compliance.
* Ability to manage large and diverse workforces across multiple locations.
* Excellent manpower planning and recruitment capabilities.

**Compensation Details**

The HR Head will play a critical role in building scalable people practices, strengthening the workforce, improving operational efficiency, and developing a strong HR framework aligned with the company's growth objectives.

**Schedule**Full Time

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Director of Human Resources will report directly to the property General Manager, with a dotted-line (functional) reporting relationship to the Regional Senior Director of Human Resources and will be an integral member of the property executive committee. As a member of the Human Resources organization, he/she contributes a high level of human resource generalist knowledge and expertise for a designated property. He/she will be accountable for talent acquisition, succession/workforce planning, performance management and development for property employees, using technology efficiently, and coaching/developing others to help influence and execute business objectives in the most efficient manner. He/she generally works with considerable independence, developing processes to accomplish objectives in alignment with broader business objectives. Additionally, he/she utilizes a Human Resource Business Plan aligned with property and brand strategies to deliver HR services that enable business success.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 4 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

* 4-year bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Managing the Human Resources Strategy**

* Executes and follows-up on engagement survey related activities.

* Champions and builds the talent management ranks in support of property and region diversity strategy.

* Translates business priorities into property Human Resources strategies, plans and actions

* Implements and sustains Human Resources initiatives at the property.

* Coordinates the human capital review process at property(s) and leads succession planning activities on property and in the market, as appropriate.

* Leads the assessment of property(s) leadership pipeline through the human capital review process and assists with follow-up.

* Creates value through proactive approaches that will affect performance outcome or control cost.

* Monitors effective use of myHR by property managers and employees.

* Leads and participates in succession management and workforce planning.

* Responsible for Human Resources strategy and execution.

* Serves as key change manager for initiatives that have high employee impact.

* Attends owners meetings as a member of the property executive committee and provides meaning or context to the Human Resources results (e.g., retention statistics, critical open positions, employee satisfaction, and training initiatives and results); and demonstrates an understanding of owner priorities.

* Supervises one or more on-property Human Resources, as well as market-based Human Resources Specialist type resources where appropriate.

**Managing Staffing and Recruitment Process**

* Analyzes open positions to balance the development of existing talent and business needs.

* Serves as coach and expert facilitator of the selection and interviewing process.

* Surfaces opportunities in work processes and staffing optimization.

* Makes staffing decisions to manage the talent cadre and pipeline at the property.

* Develops staffing strategy (in collaboration with hiring manager) relating to hiring practices; consults with hiring manager on compensation, benefits, etc.

* Monitors sourcing process and outcomes of staffing process.

* Ensures managers are competent in assessing and evaluating hourly staff.

**Managing Employee Compensation Strategy**

* Remains current and knowledgeable in the internal and external compensation and work competitive environments.

* Leads the planning of the hourly employee total compensation strategy.

* Champions the communication and proper use of total compensation systems, tools, programs, policies, etc.

* Participates in quarterly internal equity analysis; reviews internal equity reports and surface issues needing resolution.

* Creates and implement s total compensation management packages/offers, particularly recognition and incentive programs directed towards property priorities.

**Managing Staff Development Activities**

* Ensures completion of the duties and responsibilities of the properties’ Human Resources staff members, as outlined in applicable job description(s).

* Ensures property Human Resources staff is properly trained in all employee-related human resource information to appropriately respond to property employees.

* Serves as resource to property Human Resources staff on employee relations questions and issues.

* Continually reinforces positive employee relations concepts.

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a IT Senior Director to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
Cloud, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity Managed Services Operations | Experience: 14+ Years
  
At NTT DATA, we know that consistent service delivery builds lasting client trust. We invest in operational leaders who combine disciplined execution, technical understanding and strong people leadership to deliver reliable outcomes every day.
  
Role Purpose
  
The Client Delivery Manager (CDM) is accountable for day-to-day service delivery, operational governance, SLA/KPI performance, cost efficiency, resource management and continual service improvement across assigned Cloud, Infrastructure and Cybersecurity engagements.
  
  
Reporting into the Client Delivery Executive (CDE), the CDM converts contractual and client commitments into disciplined daily, weekly and monthly execution. The CDM works with the Client Architect to operationalize transformation roadmaps, automation and AIOps improvements without compromising service stability.
  
  
Lead complex enterprise operations where service reliability, operational discipline and continuous improvement directly shape client confidence. The role operates in a clear three-in-a-box model: the CDE owns the business and client outcomes, the CDM runs service operations, and the Client Architect shapes technology strategy and transformation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Service Operations Delivery Control
  

* Own daily operations across relevant service towers and ensure delivery meets SLAs, KPIs, SLOs, contractual commitments and operating procedures.
* Run daily, weekly and monthly operating rhythms, including service reviews, delivery dashboards, action tracking and closure governance.
* Maintain operational stability, service quality and business continuity across global, multi-vendor and multi-tower environments.

Incident, Problem, Change Risk Management
  

* Lead operational response for major incidents, outages, missed SLAs and service escalations; ensure timely communication, restoration and follow-through.
* Drive root-cause analysis, problem management, corrective actions and service improvement plans to prevent recurrence.
* Govern change execution, operational risks, audit actions, security/compliance obligations and continuity or disaster-recovery readiness.

Resource, Vendor Asset Management
  

* Manage workforce demand, staffing, shifts, skills, utilization, onboarding/offboarding, knowledge transfer and succession coverage.
* Coordinate tower leads, operations managers, partners and vendors; establish clear ownership and consequence-based closure of commitments.
* Oversee operational hardware/software assets, licenses and vendor dependencies within the service scope.

Cost Efficiency Financial Operations
  

* Control delivery costs in line with the account operating plan and provide accurate operational inputs for revenue, cost, margin and forecast reviews.
* Drive productivity, pyramid optimization, capacity alignment, leakage prevention and efficient ramp-up/ramp-down of resources.
* Track operational benefits from automation, continuous improvement and cost-efficiency initiatives; escalate forecast or cost gaps with corrective actions.

Client Operations Governance
  

* Serve as the primary contact for client operations leadership and lead service reviews, operational governance and action closure.
* Maintain clear and timely communication on performance, risks, incidents, recovery plans and improvement priorities.
* Support the CDE with MBR, QBR inputs, client escalations, renewals and delivery-led opportunities while keeping ownership centered on operational execution.

Automation, AIOps Continual Improvement
  

* Identify repetitive work, ticket drivers and process gaps suitable for automation, AIOps and intelligent service management.
* Partner with the Principal Client Architect and practices to implement approved improvements and embed them into standard operations.
* Measure realized outcomes such as ticket reduction, faster restoration, reduced manual effort, improved reliability and better user experience.

People Leadership
  

* Coach delivery and operations leaders, set clear expectations and build a culture of accountability, ITIL discipline, collaboration and customer focus.
* Develop operational capability, certifications, cross-skilling, engagement and retention across geographically distributed teams.

Required Experience Qualifications
  

* 14+ years in IT services or managed services, including substantial responsibility for enterprise infrastructure, cloud or cybersecurity operations.
* Proven leadership of day-to-day service delivery across complex, global and multi-tower accounts with measurable SLA/KPI and customer outcomes.
* Strong experience in major incident, problem, change, risk, transition, service improvement and operational governance.
* Working financial knowledge covering cost control, forecasting inputs, productivity, utilization and margin drivers.
* Broad understanding of cloud, compute, storage, backup, virtualization, operating systems, networks, cybersecurity and ITSM operations.
* ITIL v4 certification is required; relevant cloud, infrastructure, security or service-management certifications are preferred.
* Strong client communication, structured problem solving, data-driven decision making and ability to influence cross-functional global teams.

**About the role and team**  
  
At Uber, AI agents are increasingly writing, reviewing, testing, and debugging code in production. They deliver high-quality results efficiently, without wasting tokens, only when they understand Uber's codebases. The AI Context Engineering team builds the context foundation that every software-development AI agent at Uber relies on:  

* AI Context Graph: a unified graph of services, ownership, domain entities, and business flows
* Code Graph: a graph representation of Uber's monorepos built for agents to consume
* AI-Generated Documentation: documentation that stays fresh as code changes
* Agentic Memory: a memory layer that lets agents learn across sessions

  
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own major parts of this platform end to end. You'll take them from prototype to production at monorepo scale, and work with partner teams to integrate foundational context products with the agents running in production for workflows such as root-cause analysis, code authoring, test planning, and library upgrades, etc

* **Context Graph and Ontology:** Enrich the graph with new entity types, such as data streams, metrics, and observability signals, and link them to code so agents can reason across systems.
* **Code Graph Infrastructure:** Build and scale code graphs across multiple monorepos and microrepos, covering symbols, call edges, dependencies, and links between code and tests. Add incremental updates, versioned (historical) graphs, and function-level embeddings, and serve the graphs to agents with low latency through local and remote interfaces.
* **AI-Generated Documentation:** Extend automated documentation from backend services to mobile (screens, UI components), libraries, and data pipelines. Use refresh strategies that keep context current as code changes.
* **Agentic Memory:** Design the memory layer that lets agents persist and reuse decisions, past fixes, and team preferences across sessions.
* **Standards and Governance:** Define and roll out standards for agent instruction files (AGENTS.md), including structure, content, and token budget, and generate them systematically across modules.
* **Context Quality Evaluation:** Build continuous evals that measure the accuracy and freshness of every context product, and run A/B experiments that prove the impact on agent outcomes.
* **Tooling and Integration:** Build MCP servers, skills, and tools that deliver context to agents. Partner with AI Platform, Developer Experience, and product teams to integrate them into production workflows.
* **Technical Leadership:** Drive design reviews, mentor engineers, and turn ambiguous problems into well-scoped, measurable projects

  
**What will you need**  

* **Experience:** 8+ years of software engineering experience building production systems, with a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Programming:** Strong in Go, Java, or Python, writing clean, well-tested, maintainable code.
* **LLMs and Agentic Systems:** Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agents, including prompt and context design, tool use, and retrieval, and a good sense of what context makes agents succeed or fail.
* **Code Understanding:** Experience with static analysis, ASTs, parsers such as tree-sitter, or build and dependency systems in large codebases.
* **Data at Scale:** Experience building reliable data pipelines and working with graph or other large-scale data stores.
* **Emerging Protocols:** Familiarity with MCP and agent-to-agent protocols and how to apply them.
* **Problem Solving:** Strong analytical skills and a habit of measuring outcomes, not just shipping features.

  
**Success Metrics**  

* More agentic workflows use curated context in production, with a measured improvement in each workflow's business metric, such as accuracy, cost, latency, or CI time.
* Agents provide higher-quality, better-grounded answers while using fewer tokens and tool calls than when they rediscover context from scratch.
* Context coverage grows across languages, repos, and entity types, with measurable accuracy and freshness.

* **Graph Databases:** Experience with Neo4j or similar graph databases, including query optimization and schema design.
* **Embeddings and RAG:** Experience with embedding generation, vector databases, and retrieval pipelines.

description:
The SCADA Engineer will support delivery of SCADA, control, and communications workstreams across technical due diligence (TDD), FEED, and design projects. The role requires strong technical capability in system architecture, integration, and specification development across complex energy infrastructure projects.

  

**1. Technical Due Diligence (TDD)**

* Assess SCADA, control systems, and communication architectures for energy projects
* Review vendor documentation, design assumptions, and system configurations
* Identify key risks relating to:
  + Integration
  + Data integrity
  + Control hierarchy
  + Interface complexity
* Provide clear risk-based recommendations for clients

**2. SCADA System Design & Specifications**

* Develop:
  + SCADA architecture diagrams
  + Functional specifications
  + Signal lists and data structures
* Define system requirements including:
  + Hardware (servers, RTUs, PLCs, networks)
  + Software platforms and historian systems
* Ensure design meets project and grid requirements

**3. Interface & Integration Management**

* Define data flows and interfaces between:
  + Plant systems
  + Grid operators
  + OEM systems
* Develop Interface Control Documents (ICDs)
* Identify and mitigate integration risks across multi-system environments

**4. FEED & Detailed Design Support**

* Support design phases (30%, 60%, 90%) including:
  + Architecture definition
  + System layouts
  + Technical specifications
* Work closely with multidisciplinary teams
* Ensure design is technically robust and OEM-agnostic where required

**5. Commissioning & Validation (as required)**

* Support commissioning strategies and system validation
* Ensure compliance with relevant standards and functional requirements

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Degree in Mechanical/electrical/electronic engineering, or equivalent
* Strong experience in SCADA systems, control systems, and communications
* Experience in TDD, FEED, or design engineering
* Knowledge of protocols (IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus TCP, OPC, etc.)
* Understanding of system integration and interface risks
* Experience producing technical documentation and specifications

**Desirable**

* Experience in offshore wind, transmission, or HVDC projects
* Exposure to multi-package EPC environments
* Familiarity with grid operator requirements

description:
US Business Tax – Tax Senior – Hyderabad

  
  

Do you have a passion to work for U.S.-based clients of Deloitte Tax to provide tax compliance services? Are you ready to take the next step in your career by focusing on providing US corporate, partnership, and trust tax return compliance? Are you ready to fulfill your potential and want to have a significant impact to global initiatives? If the answer to all of the above is "Yes," come join us!

  
  

Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP ("Deloitte Tax") U.S. service lines and regions have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support practice U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option. In recent years, member firms, such as Australia, Belgium, Bermuda, Canada, the Cayman Islands, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, etc. have obtained support in their tax related practice through the Deloitte Tax in India.

  
  

Work You’ll Do

  
  

You would be working with our Bermuda, Cayman Islands, and Virgin Islands based US Business Tax team members (i.e. 30+ US tax professionals based permanently in the Caribbean and Bermuda region) and will enjoy the unique opportunity to broaden your network across the firm as a whole. This dynamic group provides exposure to an unrivalled client portfolio of multinational companies and a variety of tax work including compliance and consulting projects.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

  
  

✓ Perform detail-review of tax workpapers, allocations, and US federal, state, and local partnership, and trust tax returns and computations using standard procedures, across a range of financial services clients.

  
  

✓ Working with an integrated partner/manager/assistant manager team on sizeable US tax compliance engagements for multinational clients, including maintaining responsibility for preparation of materials and research for complex tax compliance and consulting projects related to tax planning opportunities, including those prepared by junior team members.

  
  

✓ Requesting and obtaining tax information from clients and third parties.

  
  

✓ Communicating with clients to explain positions taken on tax returns, filing requirements, payment instructions, etc.

  
  

✓ Training, mentoring, and supervising new and experienced-level staff.

  
  

The Team

  
  

Deloitte India (Offices of the Caribbean and Bermuda Countries [CBC]) US Tax Compliance Group based in Hyderabad specializes in three core areas: US partnership federal, state, and local tax return preparation, electronic filing of the returns and research and writing tax technical memorandums on a range of topics related to US partnership taxation in an international context. On taking up a position with the US team, you will have the opportunity to focus on at least two of these core specialties.

  
  

The Caribbean and Bermuda Countries member firm tax professionals who work in the US business tax practice are based in Bermuda, the Cayman Islands, and the Virgin Islands. This team of 30+ permanent professionals ranges in grades from Partner to new tax consultant who are trained as US Certified Public Accountants, IRS Enrolled Agents, bar-admitted lawyers and/or master’s degree graduates, and serves a client base consisting of a range of financial services industry clients, including hedge funds, private equity funds, fund-of-funds, and insurance companies.

  
  

Required Qualifications

  
  

✓ Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or other business-related field

  
  

✓ 4+ years of experience in US partnership tax compliance, including knowledge of, and experience using, US income tax software and standard US tax research tools

  
  

✓ Enrolled Agent (EA) certification (or in the process of pursuing)

  
  

✓ Strong accounting knowledge and interest in US tax, including extensive US partnership experience related to hedge funds.

  
  

✓ Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills, including strong written and verbal communication

  
  

✓ Experience with managing projects, including scheduling, budgeting, client correspondence, billing, team development, and mentoring

  
  

✓ High level of attention to detail, organizational skills, and analytical problem-solving abilities

  
  

✓ Can work under pressure and meet tight deadlines

  
  

✓ Knowledge of Microsoft Office products — in particular, Excel, Word, and Sharepoint

  
  

Work Location

  
  

Hyderabad

  
  

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented People Services Advisor to join our growing People Operations team in Hyderabad. This is an exciting opportunity to help establish and scale our brand-new India hub during a period of rapid expansion. In this role, you will be the backbone of our frontline HR support, delivering efficient administrative services to employees and managers across the region. As a primary point of contact for HR inquiries, you will ensure a seamless employee experience while maintaining accurate records in full compliance with local labor laws and company policies.

This role offers a hybrid work arrangement, requiring you to be in the Hyderabad office at least 3 days per week and giving you the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining 2 days. You will report to the People Services Manager on the Global People Services team.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Act as a confident and empathetic first line of support for employees, managers and stakeholders, translating complex HR processes into clear, accessible language
* Own the ticket escalation process on our case management platform: monitor incoming cases, assess urgency, collaborate with the relevant teams, and escalate complex issues to the appropriate HR specialist or HR Manager where required, managing high volumes efficiently without compromising accuracy or response times
* Execute full cycle, end-to-end HR administration while maintaining accurate and up-to-date employee records, ensuring HRIS (Workday) data integrity and confidentiality, including but not limited to:
* + Onboarding: preparation of employment contracts and new hire documentation, medical insurance registration and new joiner orientation, supporting high-volume hiring and acting as the key point of contact across HR, IT, facilities and hiring managers for a smooth first day
  + Offboarding: processing resignation and termination paperwork and conducting exit administration
  + Employee lifecycle: accurately processing high volumes of employee data changes (e.g. job changes, promotions, transfers, salary adjustments) and supporting leave and absence queries
* Support payroll preparation, ensuring records are accurate and processed in a timely manner, particularly during high-volume payroll cycles
* Prepare HR-related letters, certificates and other documents as required (e.g. employment verification and salary certificates, relieving and experience letters)
* Provide accurate and timely reporting on key people metrics and support the preparation of HR data dashboards for relevant teams, to enable data-driven decision-making across the business
* Collaborate with Government Relations, COEs, HRBPs, Talent Acquisition and IT on India statutory and regulatory requirements and any other queries on request, proactively keeping stakeholders informed
* Stay current with changes and emerging trends in India Labour Law, ensuring all HR administrative activities comply with India Labour Law, company policies and data protection requirements (including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act and GDPR principles)
* Identify opportunities to streamline HR administrative processes and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the People Services function
* Support the development and documentation of HR processes and procedures with a focus on scalability for high-volume periods, identify opportunities to use AI to address inefficiencies, and proactively recommend improvements
* Any other tasks as directed by your Line Manager

* 2–3 years' proven experience in a similar role, preferably in India
* Strong understanding of standard HR administration processes and best practices
* Foundational knowledge of India Labour Law
* Experience using Workday desirable
* Great stakeholder management skills, proactively keeping all stakeholders up to date
* Excellent organisational skills with a strong ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and document preparation

title: Product Manager
description:
**Overview:** We are seeking a dynamic and experienced individual to join our team as a Product Manager in the Core HCM domain . In this role, you will be responsible for leading initiatives to streamline and improve Global HR processes, ultim ately enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and employee experience across the organization in line with company policies and compliance.

**About this role:**

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Product Manager with deep expertise in Workday Core HCM to join the People Platforms team. In this role, you will own the product strategy and continuous improvement of our Core HCM capabilities across the Hire to Retire process (excluding the Hire process, which sits with the Talent Acquisition & Attraction (TAA) team), with particularly strong focus on the Change Job business process, as well as Termination and data management. You will also need working knowledge of Workday security and integrations to understand how changes in this space ripple across the wider Workday landscape. This is a strategic, solution-oriented position where you will collaborate with global leaders and cross-functional teams—including process owners, technology, security, and support functions—to accelerate implementation timelines, manage the product lifecycle, reduce operational issues, apply prioritization frameworks, and build a transparent, high-quality product roadmap.

The role is weighted roughly 50–70% product management and 50–30% process ownership; in practice the two are heavily intertwined, and the successful candidate will move fluidly between defining what we build and defining and standardizing how the underlying HR processes work.

**Key responsibilities**

**Product**

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Define and execute a strategic product roadmap for Workday Core HCM aligned with organizational goals and evolving market needs, with a strong emphasis on the Change Job business process, Termination, and data management across the Hire to Retire lifecycle (excluding Hire, owned by TAA).

Feature Prioritization & Backlog Management

* Collaborate with process owners, technical teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize features and enhancements based on impact, feasibility, and user feedback; own and groom the product backlog in Jira (or equivalent).

Requirements & Development Oversight

* Translate business needs into clear product requirements, well-crafted user stories, and acceptance criteria. Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle using agile methodologies, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

Quality Assurance & Testing

* Partner with solution and QA teams to define test strategies—particularly for Change Job, Termination, and other core data change scenarios—and support testing efforts to ensure the reliability and performance of product releases.

Stakeholder Engagement & Product Evangelism

* Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for your products. Communicate the product vision, roadmap, and value proposition to stakeholders and end-users.

User-Centric Design & Feedback Loops

* Engage with users to gather insights, validate solutions, and drive continuous improvement through iterative feedback and data-driven decision-making.

Training & Change Enablement

* Collaborate with change management teams to develop training materials, user guides, and communication plans that support adoption and maximize product value.

Security & Integrations Awareness

* Work with security and integration teams to understand the downstream and upstream impact of Core HCM changes (e.g., Change Job, Termination, data changes) on business process security, access, and integrations, ensuring product decisions account for these implications.

**Process**

Process Design & Documentation

* Conduct comprehensive assessments of current Hire to Retire processes (excluding Hire), particularly Change Job, Termination, and related data management workflows, to identify areas for improvement and optimization.

* Develop, implement, and maintain process documentation and guidelines, ensuring these are scalable and adaptable across regions and business units, and are clearly reflected in the supporting Workday configuration.

Process Standardization

* Develop and maintain global standards for Change Job, Termination, and data management processes to enable consistency and compliance across all regions.

* Conduct regular checks to identify variances and areas for optimization, and facilitate the sharing of best practices across regions.

Process Simplification & Automation

* Use data-driven insight (including process mining where available) to identify complex, redundant, or unnecessary steps in Change Job, Termination, and data management processes, and redesign them to remove bottlenecks and reduce errors.

* Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks and evaluate technology solutions that streamline processes and enhance the employee and HR user experience.

Continuous Improvement

* Implement continuous improvement initiatives—drawing on methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen where relevant—and define metrics and KPIs to measure process performance and track progress.

Change Management & Compliance

* Lead process change management activities tied to product releases, including training, documentation, and progress monitoring.

* Ensure Change Job, Termination, and data management processes comply with relevant data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements; support audits and help implement corrective actions where gaps are identified .

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (preferred).

* Minimum 7 years of experience as a Digital or Software Product Manager and/or Process Owner in the HR Technology domain.

* Deep, hands-on expertise in Workday Core HCM, with demonstrated strong expertise in the Change Job business process specifically; solid working knowledge of Termination and data management processes.

* Broad working knowledge of Workday more generally, with the ability to understand how Core HCM changes interact with other modules.

* Working knowledge of Workday security (e.g., domain and business process security) and integrations, sufficient to identify downstream impacts and collaborate effectively with specialist teams.

* Strong understanding of HR processes and systems in large, global, and matrixed organizations, including the wider Hire to Retire lifecycle.

* Strong experience working with agile methodologies and tools such as Jira (or similar), including facilitating agile ceremonies (e.g., stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives).

* Demonstrated strength in crafting clear, well-structured user stories and acceptance criteria.

* Experience in process design, standardization, and continuous improvement; familiarity with methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen is a plus.

* Demonstrated ability to develop business cases for automation and process improvements.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.

* Experience working with industrial or frontline organizations (e.g., retail, manufacturing, logistics ) is a plus.

* Passion for innovation and driving meaningful change in the HR tech landscape.

**Job Summary**

Provide and lead specialist analysis, design, development and deployment in network specific technology domains, including developing platform specific technology roadmaps and making technology investment recommendations to deliver products and infrastructure to defined service level standards

**Job Description**

Telstra is Australia’s leading telecommunications and technology company spanning over a century with a footprint in over 20+ countries. In India, we’re building a platform for innovative delivery and engagement that will strengthen our position as an industry leader. The Senior Solution Designer / Lead Software Engineer will provide architecture, technical design, and hands-on engineering leadership for the TNI mission. The role requires deep telecommunications OSS and physical network inventory expertise, strong knowledge of the Inventory Platform, and proven capability in designing scalable, resilient, graph-based enterprise solutions. The successful candidate will translate complex business requirements into pragmatic technical designs, implementation roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes while building effective relationships with stakeholders at all organisational levels.

Provide technical governance, design assurance, documentation, and mentoring throughout the solution lifecycle.

Digital Enablement is Nexperia's fast-track enabler of AI & Digital use-cases and platform enablement. We operate as one global practice across Nijmegen, Hamburg, Kuala Lumpur, Seremban and Bangalore, covering digital strategy, cloud and infrastructure, digital factory and enterprise, data, AI and integration.

Bangalore is where we build and ship the agentic systems that put Nexperia's AI patterns in front of real users: copilots, IDE tooling and internal automation that engineers across the company touch every day.

**About the role**

This is the senior build role for Nexperia's agent engineering practice in Bangalore. You own the architecture of the agents themselves — reasoning, planning, tool-calling and memory — and you own the surfaces people actually use them through: chat UI, IDE extensions, CLI tools and the APIs behind them.

You work closely with the Integration Architect on how agents connect into IDEs and internal systems, and with the MLOps/eval function on the quality bar an agent has to clear before it ships.

This is a hands-on role. You are still writing and reviewing code, still debugging orchestration failures when something breaks in production, and still accountable for what ships — not a role that manages from a distance.

**What you will do**

**Architect and orchestrate agents**

* Design agent architecture: reasoning loops, planning, tool-calling and memory/context management.
* Build multi-step orchestration: task decomposition, tool selection and error recovery.
* Partner with the Integration Architect on connecting agents to IDEs and internal systems.

**Ship end-to-end agent products**

* Own the build of user-facing surfaces for Copilot-style products: chat UI, IDE extensions and CLI tools.
* Build the backend APIs that connect those surfaces to agent and LLM services, including streaming responses, session state and context handling.
* Ship integrations into developer tools (VS Code extension API, LSPs, browser extensions) and own deployment of both the frontend and backend components you build.

**Set the bar and take releases live**

* Review code and agent designs from the two Junior AI Engineers, and mentor them toward independent ownership.
